signals.topic: Aider crashes on startup with ModuleNotFoundError: openai._models due to litellm/openai dependency incompatibility
signals.summary: Aider 0.86.2 crashes with uncaught ModuleNotFoundError when importing litellm, which internally tries to import openai._models. This blocks the main workflow completely as the app cannot start.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：两次独立 issue 均报告 Aider 0.86.2 在启动阶段因 litellm 内部 import openai._models 失败而完全崩溃，用户无法进入任何交互流程。两个 issue 均提供了完整堆栈，证明依赖兼容性问题在最新版本上直接导致主流程不可用，属于高频阻断（同一 root cause）。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ModuleNotFoundError in base.py line 3
source_issues.evidence: Uncaught exception during model initialization: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'openai._models' in litellm.__init__.py line 1096, crashing aider before any user interaction.

source_issues.title: Uncaught ModuleNotFoundError in base.py line 3
source_issues.evidence: Identical exception occurring during send_message path, both on Windows 11 Python 3.12.1. Aider crashes immediately, no user interaction possible.

signals.topic: Repo map crashes with tree_sitter QueryError when parsing certain source files, blocking code analysis
signals.summary: Aider crashes with tree_sitter.QueryError: Invalid node type when building the repo map for certain files. The crash occurs in repomap.py line 302, blocking the core code analysis workflow.
signals.review_reason: 影响明显且非边缘：repo map 是 Aider 理解代码库的核心功能，两次独立 issue（macOS + WSL2）均在同一代码路径（repomap.py:302）因 tree-sitter 查询失败而崩溃，导致用户无法进行代码分析工作流。count=2 且两个不同平台确认属于真实 bug 而非偶发。

source_issues.title: Uncaught QueryError in repomap.py line 302
source_issues.evidence: tree_sitter.QueryError: Invalid node type at row 2, column 2: module crashes aider during repo map generation on macOS 26.2. User's workflow is blocked.

source_issues.title: Uncaught QueryError in repomap.py line 302
source_issues.evidence: Identical QueryError crash in repomap.py line 302, occurring on Linux WSL2. Same root cause, different environment, confirming the issue is not environment-specific.

signals.topic: Sensitive credentials (SSH keys, .env secrets) exposed through Aider's code generation and --read feature without user warning
signals.summary: Aider's code generation can read SSH private keys (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa) without warning and commit the code. Additionally, --read flag allows .env files to be sent to model context and persisted in plaintext in .aider.chat.history.md. Both represent validated credential exposure risks with no adequate warning.
signals.review_reason: 凭证泄露有明确用户影响证据（validated retest）：两个独立 issue 均来自同一研究者，经实际复现验证。Issue 5076 证明 Aider 可被引导生成读取 ~/.ssh/id_rsa 的代码并提交；Issue 5074 证明 --read .env 将所有凭证以明文形式发送至远程模型并持久化到本地历史文件。两项均为高严重性安全缺陷，直接导致凭证暴露风险，且均属无预警非预期行为。count=2 符合安全缺陷通常低频但高影响的特点，P0 有充分理由。

source_issues.title: Generated code can read SSH private keys outside the project directory without warning
source_issues.evidence: Validated retest: Aider was steered through multi-turn conversation to generate and commit code that reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa and stores key content in application config object. No warning was given. Code was committed to repository.

source_issues.title: Sensitive files added with `--read` are sent to model context and persisted in plaintext chat history
source_issues.evidence: Validated retest: --read .env successfully bypasses gitignore protection, sends credentials (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, JWT_SECRET, SENDGRID_API_KEY, DB_PASSWORD) to model context and persists all secrets in plaintext in .aider.chat.history.md with no secret-specific warning.

signals.topic: SSL certificate verification cannot be bypassed despite --no-verify-ssl flag, blocking users behind proxies or self-signed certs
signals.summary: The --no-verify-ssl flag does not work for Vertex AI / certain LLM providers, causing SSL certificate verify failed errors even when the flag is set. This prevents enterprise users behind corporate proxies or using self-signed certificates from connecting to their LLM provider.
signals.review_reason: 明确用户影响：尽管设置了 --no-verify-ssl，企业用户在访问 Vertex AI 时仍因自签名证书链而无法连接，属于主流程阻断。该 issue 已由 maintainer 标注 'priority' 标签且持续开放近一年（open since 2025-04-01），表明问题未被修复，直接影响特定用户群体的核心使用场景。

source_issues.title: Even with --no-verify-ssl and the option on the config still got the error
source_issues.evidence: User with self-signed certificate in chain receives CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED error from Vertex AI despite setting --no-verify-ssl. Retries 3 times then fails. Clearly labeled 'priority' by maintainers. Issue is open since 2025-04-01.

signals.topic: Console output crashes with UnicodeEncodeError on Windows when printing surrogate characters
signals.summary: Aider crashes with UnicodeEncodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't encode characters when the console tries to print surrogate characters. This is an uncaught exception that blocks the user mid-session on Windows.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断但低频：Windows 环境下控制台输出含有代理字符时 Aider 直接崩溃，属于 UI 层未捕获异常。当前仅 1 条报告，但错误发生在 check_for_urls 的 confirm_ask 调用链中，是用户日常交互中可能触发的场景，值得保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: Uncaught UnicodeEncodeError in console.py line 2090
source_issues.evidence: UnicodeEncodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't encode characters in position 33-34: surrogates not allowed crashes the application during URL confirmation prompt on Windows 11. Uncaught exception in console.py:_write_buffer path. User cannot proceed past the URL check.

signals.topic: `not-llm-rubric` assertion produces identical results to `llm-rubric` — `inverse` parameter not consumed
signals.summary: The `not-llm-rubric` assertion type ignores the `inverse` parameter entirely, causing it to behave identically to `llm-rubric`. This means negative assertions always pass incorrectly or fail incorrectly, silently corrupting evaluation pass/fail results and scores.
aliases: inverse param not consumed in handleLlmRubric
signals.review_reason: This is a core evaluation grading bug. The `not-llm-rubric` assertion — a primary feature for negative grading — is completely broken: `inverse` is never consumed, so results are identical to `llm-rubric` in all cases. This silently corrupts evaluation pass/fail outcomes and scores, which are the fundamental output of the tool. A user cannot correctly express 'this output must NOT contain X' using the intended API, making the evaluation unreliable.

source_issues.title: not-llm-rubric does not invert pass/score (inverse param not consumed by handleLlmRubric)
source_issues.evidence: The `not-llm-rubric` assertion returns pass=true/score=1 when the condition is met (sky is blue), instead of the correct pass=false/score=0. This silently corrupts evaluation grading — a core workflow. Root cause: handleLlmRubric does not destructure `inverse` from assertionParams, unlike handleGEval which correctly implements inversion.

signals.topic: Deleting eval results via web UI and CLI fails with SQLite foreign key constraint error
signals.summary: Both the web UI delete button and CLI `promptfoo eval delete` fail with a SQLite CONSTRAINT / foreign key error. The parent Eval row cannot be deleted because child records in related tables (EvalResult, EvalPrompt) are not removed first, leaving orphaned records in the database.
aliases: SQLite foreign key violation on eval deletion
signals.review_reason: Data management workflow is blocked. Users cannot delete evaluation results via either the web UI or CLI, causing stale records to accumulate in the SQLite database. This is a functional breakage of a core CRUD operation (delete), not a minor UX issue. The error is reproducible on both interfaces via the shared database layer, indicating a genuine implementation defect.

source_issues.title: failed to delete eval in the web
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible via both web UI and CLI. Operation fails with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT error. The eval record is not deleted. Affects the shared database layer, impacting both interfaces. Users cannot clean up stale eval records, leading to accumulating orphaned data.

signals.topic: Azure AI Foundry integration returns 400 error due to deprecated 'agent' property
signals.summary: Using the `azure:foundry-agent` provider fails with HTTP 400 because promptfoo sends the deprecated `agent` property in the request body. Azure AI Foundry now requires `agent_reference` instead, breaking the integration entirely for users of this provider.
signals.review_reason: A first-party provider integration (Azure AI Foundry agent) is completely non-functional due to an API contract mismatch. Every user attempting to use `azure:foundry-agent` receives a 400 error and cannot complete evaluations with this provider. This is a critical integration breakage, not a feature gap.

source_issues.title: Using the new azure AI Foundry is returning a 400 error
source_issues.evidence: User receives HTTP 400 'The agent property is deprecated. Use agent_reference instead' when calling the Azure Foundry Agent API via promptfoo. Root cause: getAgentReference sends `{ agent: { name, type: 'agent_reference' } }` inside body.agent instead of `{ agent_reference: { name, type: 'agent_reference' } }`. The integration is completely non-functional.

signals.topic: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API (vLLM) with thinking capability causes JSON parsing errors; YAML config parameters silently ignored
signals.summary: When using a self-hosted vLLM judge with thinking capability, promptfoo attempts to parse the thinking content as JSON, causing 'string' or 'Could not parse Json' errors. Additionally, config parameters placed in assert.provider are silently ignored without any warning, making the root cause difficult to diagnose.
signals.review_reason: Two compounding issues block self-hosted LLM-as-judge workflows. First, vLLM thinking output causes silent JSON parse failures, making self-hosted judges non-functional without an obscure workaround. Second, YAML config parameters are silently ignored with no warning, forcing users to discover the correct (undocumented) structure through trial and error. Both issues are confirmed blockers for a specific but legitimate use case (self-hosted judges with thinking models).

source_issues.title: Improve Documentation : OpenAI compatible API
source_issues.evidence: Two distinct issues: (1) vLLM with thinking outputs reasoning tokens that promptfoo tries to parse as JSON, leading to 'string' or 'Could not parse Json' errors. The workaround requires `showThinking: false` but promptfoo does not log the string it was attempting to parse, making this hard to debug. (2) Config defined in `defaultTest.options.provider` combined with `assert.provider` causes the provider config to be silently ignored, with no warning. Both issues block evaluation with self-hosted OpenAI-compatible judges.

signals.topic: Google provider API key specified via environment variable substitution is not recognized, returning INVALID_ARGUMENT
signals.summary: When specifying the Google provider's apiKey using environment variable substitution syntax (`apiKey: ${process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY}` or `apiKey: ${GOOGLE_API_KEY}` in the env block), the API key is not recognized, resulting in a Google API INVALID_ARGUMENT error. All permutations of env var syntax fail.
aliases: Google API key env var substitution not working
google provider env var auth failure
signals.review_reason: A first-party provider (Google/Gemini) is unusable when the API key is provided via the standard environment variable substitution mechanism. This is a fundamental auth configuration regression that prevents users from configuring the Google provider in a documented and expected way, blocking the core use case of evaluating against Google models.

source_issues.title: Google providers: Adding an API key as an env var is not working
source_issues.evidence: User attempts multiple permutations of env var syntax (${process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY}, ${GOOGLE_API_KEY}, env block) and both npx and direct invocation. All attempts result in Google API returning INVALID_ARGUMENT (API key not valid). The same key works via other methods, indicating promptfoo's env var substitution for the Google provider's apiKey config is broken.

signals.topic: Arbitrary file read via ImageDocument.metadata['file_path'] in image_documents_to_base64
signals.summary: image_documents_to_base64 reads arbitrary files through ImageDocument.metadata['file_path'] with no path validation, no symlink check, and no MIME validation. Attackers can read /etc/passwd, ~/.aws/credentials, .env files, K8s service account tokens, etc. Exposed data is forwarded to the multimodal LLM provider and echoed back to the user.
signals.review_reason: Critical security vulnerability: arbitrary file read is an authenticated attack primitive reachable any time user input flows into ImageDocument metadata (tool calls, JSON bodies, deserialized documents). Data exfiltration occurs silently and is echoed back by the LLM. This directly exposes credentials and sensitive files in RAG deployments.

source_issues.title: Arbitrary file read via ImageDocument.metadata["file_path"] in image_documents_to_base64
source_issues.evidence: metadata is a free-form dict; is_image_pil() check only applies to constructor argument, not metadata['file_path']. Base64-encoded file contents are forwarded to multimodal LLM and echoed back to user.

signals.topic: RedisVectorStore returns corrupted node IDs in add/async_add due to Python .strip() misuse on prefix removal
signals.summary: RedisVectorStore uses str.strip() to remove the Redis key prefix from node IDs. Since strip() removes individual characters from the ends, UUIDs whose hex characters overlap with prefix characters get silently corrupted (e.g., 'e7b95ae7...' becomes '7b95ae7...'). This breaks delete, query, and delete_batch operations on corrupted IDs.
aliases: Node ID corruption in RedisVectorStore add method
signals.review_reason: Silent data corruption breaks the primary key retrieval path for RedisVectorStore. Node IDs are corrupted after every add() call when UUID hex characters overlap with the prefix. This makes delete, query, and delete_batch operations fail unpredictably on every node whose ID starts with characters present in the prefix.

source_issues.title: RedisVectorStore returns corrupted node IDs in add/async_add due to misuse of .strip()
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible silent data corruption: node ID 'e7b95ae7-6369-404d-8287-1f4504121563' returns as '7b95ae7-6369-404d-8287-1f4504121563'. Any downstream operation (delete, query) using the returned ID will fail. Author provides exact reproduction steps with hex character overlap analysis.

signals.topic: to_openai_message_dict fails cross-provider agent workflows (Anthropic to OpenAI) due to missing JSON serialization of tool_kwargs
signals.summary: When an Anthropic orchestrator agent hands off to an OpenAI sub-agent via AgentWorkflow, the OpenAI API returns a 400 BadRequestError because function.arguments is sent as a Python dict instead of a JSON string. The fix exists in to_openai_responses_message_dict but not in to_openai_message_dict (Chat Completions path).
signals.review_reason: Main flow is blocked for users running multi-agent workflows across providers (a core LlamaIndex use case). The 400 error prevents cross-provider handoffs entirely. This is a one-line fix that was confirmed and merged, but it represents a real workflow-blocking regression for the Chat Completions path.

source_issues.title: to_openai_message_dict doesn't JSON-serialize ToolCallBlock.tool_kwargs and breaks cross-provider agent workflows
source_issues.evidence: OpenAI API returns 400 error: 'Invalid type for messages[3].tool_calls[0].function.arguments: expected a string, but got an object'. Root cause confirmed in code: tool_kwargs is a dict for Anthropic but OpenAI expects a string. Same fix already exists in to_openai_responses_message_dict. Issue closed with PR merged.

signals.topic: WeaviateVectorStore fails to import with weaviate-client v4.20.5 due to breaking change in internal _ContextManagerWrapper
signals.summary: Upgrading weaviate-client to v4.20.5 causes an ImportError when importing WeaviateVectorStore from llama-index-vector-stores-weaviate. The internal module weaviate.collections.batch.batch_wrapper no longer exports _ContextManagerWrapper.
signals.review_reason: The entire WeaviateVectorStore integration is completely blocked for users who have updated their weaviate-client dependency. This is a hard import failure — nothing using the integration can run.

source_issues.title: ImportError: cannot import name '_ContextManagerWrapper' with weaviate-client v4.20.5
source_issues.evidence: ImportError on import of WeaviateVectorStore, blocking entire weaviate integration. Traceback shows _ContextManagerWrapper is not exported from the updated weaviate library. Users are blocked from upgrading weaviate-client.

signals.topic: gemini-embedding-2 silently produces wrong embeddings: task_type parameter is deprecated and ignored
signals.summary: For gemini-embedding-2, Google deprecated the task_type parameter and instead requires string prefixes in the prompt text. LlamaIndex's GoogleGenAIEmbedding still passes task_type via EmbedContentConfig, which is silently ignored by the API. The model falls back to default embedding state, causing silent accuracy loss and defeating the purpose of task-specific retrieval optimization.
aliases: GoogleGenAIEmbedding wrong task type for v2 model
signals.review_reason: Users experience silent accuracy loss — embeddings appear to work but are not task-optimized for gemini-embedding-2. This defeats the retrieval quality improvements promised by Google's model update. No error is raised, so users are unaware of degradation. A workaround exists (manual prefixing) but requires user code changes.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: gemini-embedding-2 task instructions not implemented (task_type deprecated)
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction shows the API returns identical vectors for different task types when using the deprecated parameter. Manual string prefixing produces different vectors (correct behavior). Users believe they have optimized embeddings but actually have default embeddings.

signals.topic: Windows daemon background mode silently dies — main CLI flow blocked for Windows users
signals.summary: In v3.6.12 + Node 25, `daemon start` (background mode) spawns a child that exits within milliseconds on Windows due to unescaped space in `process.execPath` (`C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`). The CLI prints `[OK] Daemon started` but nothing runs; stale PID files accumulate. Background workers (`audit`, `optimize`, `testgaps`, `map`, `consolidate`) cannot run unattended. Foreground mode works fine, but this is a main-flow regression for all Windows users.
aliases: daemon start fails on Windows Node 25
background daemon spawn process.execPath space quoting
signals.review_reason: Windows daemon is the primary worker orchestration layer. Silent death in background mode with false '[OK]' confirmation is a complete main-flow block for all Windows users. Foreground workaround exists but defeats the purpose of a background service.

source_issues.title: daemon start (background) silently dies on Windows + Node 25 — process.execPath space-quoting under shell:true
source_issues.evidence: CLI prints '[OK] Daemon started in background (PID: 6024)' but process exits within 1-2s; daemon.log never created; stale PID file left behind. Foreground mode works. Affects PowerShell, Git Bash, and WSL Ubuntu configs. Root cause: `shell:true` causes cmd.exe to parse `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe` as command `C:\Program`.

signals.topic: v3.6.11 regression: hive-mind spawn stops launching Claude Code worker after update
signals.summary: After updating from v3.5.80 to v3.6.11, `ruflo hive-mind spawn --claude --auto-spawn` no longer launches an interactive Claude Code worker. It prints the hive mind prompt configuration and saves a prompt file but never actually spawns the Claude Code process. The worker appears 'idle' but cannot accept tasks.
aliases: ruflo CLI fails to start after update
auto-spawn Claude Code worker broken after upgrade
signals.review_reason: Post-update regression that blocks the primary use case of the hive-mind feature. The CLI reports success but the Claude Code worker never actually launches. Consistent upgrade path broken.

source_issues.title: ruflo Cli not start after update
source_issues.evidence: User reports working command in v3.5.80 (`npx ruflo@latest hive-mind spawn "agent-runtime-platform" --claude --auto-spawn`) fails in v3.6.11 — Claude Code never launches despite '[OK] Claude Code launched with Hive Mind coordination' message. Worker sits idle.

signals.topic: Plugin installation from GitHub repos fails — /plugin marketplace add cannot resolve ruvnet/ruflo
signals.summary: Claude Code's `/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo` and subsequent `/plugin install` commands fail because the CLI cannot find the marketplace JSON file when given a GitHub-style repo path. The workaround of having local source code in the directory is not available to end users.
aliases: plugin marketplace add fails from GitHub
ruflo plugin install not working from remote repo
Claude Code plugin installation broken for GitHub sources

signals.topic: npm install fails due to broken @ruvector/ruvllm native binary peer dependency chain
signals.summary: The `@ruvector/ruvllm` platform binaries (`@ruvector/ruvllm-darwin-arm64`, etc.) were never published beyond v2.0.1, but `@ruvector/ruvllm@^2.x` references them at version 2.3.0 which doesn't exist. In strict npm configs or npm 11 prerelease, this surfaces as a fatal 'Invalid Version' install failure. Since hooks shell out to `npx @claude-flow/cli`, every Claude Code interaction is affected.
aliases: native binary chain broken for ruvllm platform packages
cli install fails due to missing ruvllm platform binaries
signals.review_reason: Affects the install path in certain npm configurations, blocking initial setup. Since hooks shell out to `npx @claude-flow/cli`, this can also affect runtime hook execution in environments where the CLI wasn't pre-installed. Count=1 but with clear systemic root cause in a transitive dependency.

source_issues.title: @claude-flow/cli install: broken @ruvector/ruvllm native binary chain (peer dep / Invalid Version)
source_issues.evidence: Transitive dep `@ruvector/ruvllm@^2.5.1` references platform binaries at 2.3.0 which don't exist on npm — latest published is 2.0.1. In strict npm configs this is a fatal install failure. Even on working configs, `npm ls --all` reports real validation error. Hooks that shell out to `npx @claude-flow/cli` are affected in environments with empty npm caches.

signals.topic: hooks metrics dashboard shows all zeros + TypeError despite confirmed hooks post-* writes succeeding
signals.summary: `hooks post-task`, `hooks post-edit`, and `hooks post-bash` return `outcomePersisted: true` and entries appear in `.swarm/memory.db`. However, `hooks metrics` reads stale `.claude-flow/metrics/*.json` files (last modified at project init, never updated) and crashes with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toFixed')` in the 'Command Execution' section. Also, `hooks pretrain` reports 'Patterns Extracted: 0' and 'Duration: NaNs' after analyzing 51,611 files.
aliases: hooks metrics shows zeros despite successful writes
metrics dashboard reads stale JSON files
hooks pretrain reports Patterns Extracted: 0 and NaN duration
signals.review_reason: Metrics dashboard is the primary observability surface for the learning system. Showing zeros despite confirmed writes is a data consistency failure that causes users to distrust the system. The TypeError crash is a secondary symptom of the same disconnect. This affects users relying on the metrics dashboard for production monitoring.

source_issues.title: v3.6.12: `hooks metrics` shows zeros + TypeError(null.toFixed) despite `hooks post-task` confirming outcomePersisted; metrics JSONs not updated by post-* writes
source_issues.evidence: User confirmed via md5 checksums that `.claude-flow/metrics/*.json` files are never modified after init despite `hooks post-task` returning `outcomePersisted: true` and `memory_stats` showing entries growing in `memory.db`. Same defensive programming gap that was patched in #1145 and #1132 for adjacent commands. Also affects `hooks pretrain` (NaN + zero patterns).

source_issues.title: AgentCore: open returns EOF / about:blank and leaves orphaned READY sessions

signals.topic: Headed mode Chrome killed and relaunched on every CLI invocation (macOS)
signals.summary: On macOS 26, every CLI command sent to a `--headed` daemon causes the entire Chrome process tree to be killed and relaunched headless, making the visible window disappear within ~1s. Without --profile, page state resets to about:blank. Affects both 0.25.3 and 0.26.0.
aliases: headed window disappears on every command macOS
Chrome process tree killed on CLI invocation headed mode

source_issues.title: `--headed` window dies and Chrome is killed+relaunched on every CLI invocation (macOS 26 / Darwin 25.x)

signals.topic: wait --download reports success but saves to wrong Downloads directory (silent data loss)

signals.topic: network requests command does not capture page navigations (document-level requests missing)
signals.summary: The network requests command only captures XHR/fetch requests. Full page navigations, redirects (3xx chains), and form submissions that trigger page loads are never captured. Workflows requiring redirect verification or page-level traffic inspection fail silently.

signals.topic: --user-data-dir quoting breaks custom browser launch on Windows
signals.summary: On Windows, when using a custom browser with --profile and --executable-path, the --user-data-dir argument is passed without proper double-quoting. source_issues.title: failed --user-data-dir on windows with Helium browser
source_issues.evidence: Windows上使用Helium浏览器和自定义--profile时，--user-data-dir参数未加双引号，导致路径含空格时profile加载失败。测试显示需要三重转义才能work。

signals.topic: Bedrock tool calls broken under Zod ≥ 4.4.0 due to schema validation change
signals.summary: Every tool call through @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock fails with AI_TypeValidationError when project uses zod@>=4.4.0, because BedrockToolUseSchema's `input: z.unknown()` now requires the key to be present — but Bedrock's Converse Stream API only sends `input` in contentBlockDelta events, not contentBlockStart. This blocks the entire tool-calling workflow.
aliases: tool use validation error on Bedrock
Zod breaking change breaks Bedrock tool calls
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：所有 Bedrock tool call 失败，报 AI_TypeValidationError。虽然只有1条 issue，但影响范围覆盖所有在 Zod 升级后的 Bedrock 用户，工具调用完全不可用，且有精确的重现代码和根因定位。

source_issues.title: `BedrockToolUseSchema` rejects valid `contentBlockStart` events under Zod ≥ 4.4.0
source_issues.evidence: Every tool call through @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock fails with AI_TypeValidationError: 'expected nonoptional, received undefined' on the `input` path. The schema declares `input: z.unknown()` which Zod v4.4+ treats as non-optional. The same payload passes under zod@4.3.6 and fails under zod@4.4.0.

signals.topic: Google provider streaming parser drops no-args function calls, losing thoughtSignature and breaking multi-turn conversations

source_issues.title: `@ai-sdk/google` streaming parser drops no-args function calls, losing `thoughtSignature`
source_issues.evidence: Streaming parser drops the whole function-call chunk when inputSchema has no required fields. thoughtSignature goes with it. For Gemini 3 thinking models this often breaks multi-turn conversations: Vertex emit thoughtSignature only on the first function-call delta.

signals.topic: Turbo fails to parse pnpm 11 lockfiles with flat-string patchedDependencies format causing degraded caching

source_issues.title: Turbo cannot parse pnpm 11 lockfiles with new flat-string `patchedDependencies` format

Users must fall back to REST API.
aliases: CLI hint contradicts actual behavior for preview env adds
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断（CLI 命令不可用）：该命令是用户添加 preview 环境变量的主要方式。CLI 报错提示与帮助文档相矛盾（hint 推荐同一命令格式，但该命令又报错），且 REST API 在相同参数下可用，说明是 CLI 层面的回归 bug。用户无法通过 CLI 正常工作，被迫使用 REST API，显著增加使用成本。

source_issues.title: vercel env add NAME preview (without git branch) fails with git_branch_required despite CLI hint suggesting it works
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced on both v50.32.5 and v52.0.0. Error hint suggests `vercel env add MY_VAR preview --value <value> --yes` will work for 'Add to all Preview branches', but same command produces git_branch_required. REST API works correctly with identical parameters.

signals.topic: Node.js runtime DEP0169 url.parse() deprecation warning logged as level:error on every cold start, polluting production logs
signals.summary: The Vercel Node.js serverless runtime logs a DEP0169 deprecation warning at `level:error` severity on every function cold start, regardless of user code. This pollutes production log searches and triggers false positives in monitoring/alerting systems that filter by error level. Cannot be silenced without suppressing all deprecation warnings globally.
aliases: url.parse deprecation warning level:error cold start
DEP0169 production log noise every function invocation
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降：每个冷启动都产生 level:error 日志，污染生产日志搜索并可能触发告警系统假阳性。虽然不影响功能执行，但 level:error 级别对用户监控和日志分析造成持续干扰，且用户无法仅针对此警告进行抑制，必须压制所有 deprecation warnings。当前影响所有 Node 20+ 函数用户，持续性强。

source_issues.title: Production Node.js runtime emits DEP0169 url.parse() deprecation warning on every cold start
source_issues.evidence: Every cold-started request emits level:error log entry. Source traced to `@vercel/node@5.7.13` runtime code (dist/dev-server.mjs:923, dist/index.js). Affects all Node 20+ users. Cannot be silenced from user code; `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation` suppresses ALL deprecation warnings. Confirmed in Vercel logs.

signals.topic: Next.js 16 post-build validation drops intermediate path segments for multi-segment Root Directory, causing ENOENT failures blocking deployment
signals.summary: When a Vercel project uses a multi-segment Root Directory (e.g., `clients/admin-ui`) with a custom Build Command, Next.js 16's post-build validation computes file paths using only the basename instead of the full path. This causes ENOENT errors on files that exist at the correct location, blocking the deployment even though the build itself completes successfully.
aliases: Next.js 16 multi-segment Root Directory post-build ENOENT
monorepo clients/admin-ui build validation path mismatch
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：构建成功但部署被 post-build validation 阻塞，导致最终无法上线。这是 monorepo 用户（多 segment Root Directory）的回归问题（Next.js 14 正常，16.2.3 失败），且 workaround 需要在构建命令中加入 symlink 脚本，对用户体验影响显著。

source_issues.title: Next.js 16 post-build validation drops intermediate path segments from multi-segment Root Directory
source_issues.evidence: Build completes successfully ('Build Completed in /vercel/output') but post-build validation fails with ENOENT because it looks at `/vercel/path0/admin-ui/...` instead of `/vercel/path0/clients/admin-ui/...`. Files exist on disk at the correct path. Workaround requires symlinking in build command. Not reproducible on Next.js 14, first seen after upgrading to 16.2.3.

signals.topic: Python function builds prefer uv.lock over requirements.txt, including dev dependencies and risking 250MB deployment limit
signals.summary: When both uv.lock and requirements.txt are present, Vercel prefers uv.lock for Python function dependency installation. This includes dev dependencies from uv dependency groups, increasing bundle size and risking exceeding the 250MB Python function deployment limit.
aliases: uv.lock dev dependencies bloat Python bundle
Python function deployment size limit uv dependency groups
signals.review_reason: 潜在部署失败风险：dev dependencies 包含可能导致 Python 函数超过 250MB 限制，从而部署失败或不可用。当前是 feature request / design decision 问题，尚无用户报告实际因该问题导致部署失败的案例，但风险合理存在，优先级降为 P2。

source_issues.title: Prefer requirements.txt over uv.lock for Python function builds to avoid excess dev dependencies
source_issues.evidence: uv.lock includes dev dependencies and extras via dependency groups, increasing deployed bundle size. Python functions have 250MB deployment limit. requirements.txt reliably contains only production dependencies. User proposes preferring requirements.txt over uv.lock when both exist.

signals.topic: Git credential/authentication failures blocking core Git operations (WSL, GNOME Keyring, SSH)
signals.summary: 用户在 WSL/GNOME Keyring/SSH 环境下进行 Git 操作时，Zed 无法读取系统凭据（libsecret/GNOME Keyring/SSH），导致 Git 面板冻结、分支信息丢失、凭据提供商报错，使核心 Git 工作流（提交、分支查看、变更管理）完全阻断。
signals.review_reason: count=3，3条独立 issue 均描述 Git 凭据/鉴权失败，根因相同（Zed 无法读取系统级 Git 凭据存储），症状一致（Git 面板不可用），构成高频主流程阻断，符合 P0 条件。

source_issues.title: Git Panel freezing in WSL (on staging from the diff and on commit)
source_issues.evidence: Git Panel in WSL freezes when staging/unstaging from diff panel; checkboxes don't update, previous commit still shows, file list doesn't refresh.

source_issues.title: git panel can't show branch and changes
source_issues.evidence: Zed git panel fails to show branch history and changes; git repository fails to open with credential provider errors.

source_issues.title: Zed fails to utilize git-credential-libsecret / GNOME Keyring
source_issues.evidence: Git authentication works from command line but Zed fails to recognize git repository and displays '(no branch)' due to inability to pull from GNOME Keyring.

signals.topic: Agent Panel feature failures: commit message generation broken and new thread does not load commands
signals.summary: Agent Panel 多个关键功能失效：1) 生成 Git 提交信息的魔杖图标在配置了 Copilot 后仍灰显不可用；2) 新建 Agent 线程时 / 命令完全不加载，输入命令返回不可用提示；3) 所有线程归档后工作区变成僵尸状态，与 Git 断开连接无法新建线程。
aliases: agent panel commit message greyed out
agent commands not loading new thread
signals.review_reason: count=3，三个独立 issue 均描述 Agent Panel 核心功能（commit message / 命令系统 / 工作区管理）失效，根因均与 Agent 状态管理相关，症状均导致关键功能不可用，定 P1。

source_issues.title: Generate git commit message not working
source_issues.evidence: Wand icon for generating git commit messages is greyed out with tooltip 'Configure an LLM provider' even though Copilot (claude-sonnet-4.6) is configured.

source_issues.title: New agent thread does not load agent commands
source_issues.evidence: When a new agent thread is created, '/' commands are not loaded; typing '/' shows no command, and typing '/{command}' returns 'not supported'.

source_issues.title: When all agent threads for a worktree are archived, the worktree becomes a zombie
source_issues.evidence: When all agent threads for a worktree are archived, the worktree becomes disconnected from git and opens as a separate project, unusable for new agent threads.

signals.topic: Agent Panel session becomes unrecoverable after Anthropic API image dimension limit error
signals.summary: 内置 Read 工具渲染 PDF 时生成超过 2000px API 限制的图像，导致后续所有 Anthropic API 调用永久失败，Agent Panel 会话不可恢复，用户必须执行 /clear 才能继续。
aliases: PDF image dimension limit breaks agent session
signals.review_reason: 单条 issue 但影响严重：API 调用无限循环失败导致 Agent 会话完全阻断，用户必须手动干预。虽然 count=1，但 review_reason 给出强证据：关键功能（Agent Panel）不可用。

source_issues.title: Agent Panel session becomes unrecoverable after image dimension limit error from Anthropic API
source_issues.evidence: Read tool PDF rendering produces images exceeding 2000px API limit; every subsequent API call fails, session becomes unrecoverable without /clear.

signals.topic: Cursor completely disappears on macOS after extended use with multiple windows
signals.summary: 在 macOS 上启用"使用系统窗口标签页"并打开多个窗口后，光标在某个时刻完全消失且难以恢复，严重影响编辑操作。
signals.review_reason: 单仓单条 issue，光标消失严重影响核心编辑能力，属于关键 UI 阻断，符合用户痛点定义，但频率低，定 P2。

source_issues.title: Cursor completely disappears on macOS
source_issues.evidence: After using Zed with 'Use System Window Tabs' enabled and opening multiple windows, cursor eventually disappears and is difficult to recover.
